content:
Maya: Heads-up 1: proposing a staged regional roll for the fallback policy with per-tenant opt-in and a clear kill-chain. Want to bake auditability and a single-click fallback in Console. Thoughts?
Priya: Love the per-tenant opt-in. For legal/compliance we need an audit trail (actor, action, reason) and retention metadata. Can we attach a ticket id to flag flips?
Ben: Telemetry requirements: tag every trace with rollout_id, slice_id, tenant_id, and decision_point. Metrics to gate on: p95 latency, 5xx%, regen-rate, and quality_delta on eval harness. Also track cost_delta (USD/token) as a safety net.
Carlos: Ops concerns: regional pause windows. If a region spikes we should be able to pause only that region slice for up to X hours without touching others. Also add an option to drain vs immediate cutover.
Olivia: Runbook ask: single-button kill-switch in Console that does 3 things atomically: set flag to fallback_variant, scale concurrency to 0 for canary pool, emit rollback telemetry event and page SRE. UI should show pre-flight confirmation and prefilled reason template.
Maya: Proposed flag JSON we'll store in rollout record (example):
```json
{"rollout_id":"r-20260325-01","start_ts":"2026-03-25T02:00:00Z","slices":[{"percentage":1,"regions":["us-west-2"],"type":"canary"}],"ramp_hours":48,"pause_windows":[{"region":"eu-central-1","max_pause_hours":8}],"latency_gate_ms":30,"error_rate_gate":0.002,"quality_delta_pct":1.5,"cost_delta_usd_per_1k_tokens":0.15,"fallback_variant":"mistral-7b-fallback","audit_ticket":"T12345"}
```
Priya: That audit_ticket field is perfect. Legal-bot should be able to append review status automatically.
legal-bot: Auto-check: enterprise contract clause present? pending.
Ben: For A/B: run randomized cohorts per-tenant where possible. Run length: min 7 days post-ramp. Evaluate top-line quality on our canonical eval set + a lightweight customer telemetry signal (safety flags/hallucination reports).
Carlos: Autoscale note: temporarily override autoscaler for canary pool to keep concurrency low, then restore. Include a script to revert overrides in runbook.
Olivia: Automatic rollback rules proposal: if (p95 latency > baseline + 30ms AND 5xx_rate delta > 0.2% sustained for 15m) OR (quality_delta_pct > 2% for 1h) OR (cost_delta > configured threshold) -> auto-fallback and page SRE. Manual kill should be immediate and show expected downstream actions.
Maya: We should also schedule a 24h shadow period before canary where traffic is mirrored to fallback variant in non-prod regions to validate KV cache and latency distribution.
Priya: Data retention and visibility: audit log for flag flips stored for 7 years for enterprise; UI must show flip history and the actor.
Ben: Instrumentation: emit metric snapshots at these steps: pre-ramp baseline, hour-0, hour-6, hour-24, end-of-ramp, and on any rollback. Schema: rollout_id, slice_id, step, metrics_map (serialize).
Carlos: Add a throttled alert to prevent oscillation: once a region is auto-paused, dont auto-resume for at least 30 minutes without human ack.
Olivia: Ops will draft the runbook. Must include: how to flip flag, revert autoscale, warm caches, re-route traffic, expected customer impact text. Also add a checklist for dedicated vs hosted scenarios.
Maya: Action items: Olivia write runbook this week; Ben wire tags + metric snapshots; Carlos add autoscale override script; Priya confirm legal retention; I'll update the product spec and feature flag schema. Reconvene 48h before the canary. :spiral_calendar:
release-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-27T02:00:00Z, slice=1% us-west-2, shadowing enabled 24h prior.
